name: @deepsea/tool-system-permissions
description: DeepSea plugin: a `seek_system_permission` tool that makes sure macOS privacy permissions (Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Camera, Input Monitoring, Full Disk Access, Automation of an app) are granted to the app the agent's commands run under. It returns at once when they are; otherwise its card lists each one with a tick, a question mark (Grant and Deny) or a cross, polls in fresh processes until each is granted or denied, and opens System Settings by itself after a minute without a click.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check tools.js && node --check seek.mjs && node --check permissions.mjs && node --check macos.mjs && node --check fake.mjs && node --check panel-page.mjs && node --check command.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs

deepsea.machineWide: macOS privacy permissions of the app this server runs under (its server host, which a throwaway shares with the variant that started it): asks macOS to show its permission prompts and opens System Settings' Privacy & Security panes
